definitions.explanation: A policy of closing a country's borders to foreign trade and contact. Most commonly refers to Japan's isolationist policy during the Edo period (1639–1853), when foreign trade was severely restricted.

examples.japanese: ⟦{江戸|えど}{時代|じだい}→江戸時代：20431_edojidai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{鎖国|さこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧だった。
examples.english: The Edo period was an era of national isolation.

examples.japanese: {鎖国|さこく}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧オランダ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{貿易|ぼうえき}→貿易：01727_boueki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧。
examples.english: Even during national isolation, trade with the Dutch continued in Nagasaki.

examples.japanese: ペリー⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{来航|らいこう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きっかけ→きっかけ：10309_kikkake⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧200⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦{続|つづ}いた→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧{鎖国|さこく}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{終|お}わらせた。
examples.english: Prompted by Perry's arrival, Japan ended its approximately 200-year policy of national isolation.

notes:
Literally "locking the country" — {鎖|さ} (lock/chain) + {国|こく} (country).

Japan's {鎖国|さこく} lasted from 1639 to 1853. During this period, limited trade was permitted through {出島|でじま} in ⟦{長崎|ながさき}→長崎：30731_nagasaki⟧ with the Dutch and Chinese. The policy ended with the arrival of American Commodore Perry and the subsequent ⟦{開国|かいこく}→開国：14660_kaikoku⟧ (opening of the country).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {鎖国|さこく}⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧ (isolation policy)
- {鎖国|さこく}⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧ (period of isolation)
- {鎖国|さこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{解|と}く→解く：02301_toku⟧ (to lift the isolation policy)

The antonym is ⟦{開国|かいこく}→開国：14660_kaikoku⟧ (opening of a country to foreign relations).
